title: Yellow Energy Character Poses
description: Three distinct poses of a cartoon girl with spiky yellow hair and a black-and-yellow outfit are displayed side by side. The left pose shows her standing and firing a bright yellow energy blast from her hand, the middle pose depicts her spinning inside a swirling blue energy ring, and the right pose shows her flying horizontally with small yellow energy orbs orbiting her head.
prompt: Cartoon girl with wild spiky bright yellow hair, wearing a black and yellow futuristic outfit with boots and gloves, shown in three separate action poses against a dark gray background. Left: standing and shooting a bright yellow starburst energy blast from her hand. Middle: mid-air spinning inside a large swirling blue energy ring. Right: flying horizontally with small yellow energy orbs circling her head. Chibi anime style, clean lines, vibrant colors, dynamic action.
